source: MDPI Information 2026 — Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets (doi:10.3390/info17010056)
title: EV-Filter Decision Layer + Fractional-Kelly Staking + Systematic Rolling Windows
summary: MDPI 2026 paper shows XGBoost achieves Brier 0.202 but only +43.8% ROI over 36 bets — inferior to uncertainty-aware LSTM with EV-filtering (+sustained bankroll growth). Key insight: calibration alone is insufficient; the decision layer (EV threshold + Kelly multiplier) drives actual returns. Paper also uses systematic 5-game rolling form indicators. Three actionable improvements for our tree-based system.
key_finding: Logistic regression achieves Brier 0.199 — better than our current fleet leader 0.22249. This suggests we have a feature quality / calibration gap solvable with tabular ML without neural nets.

proposals.title: EV-Filter: Only bet when EV > 1.10
proposals.description: Filter predictions to only generate bets when Expected Value exceeds 1.10 (10% edge). The MDPI paper shows this alone dramatically improves ROI by suppressing low-confidence marginal bets. Currently our bankroll_manager.py bets on any positive-EV signal.
proposals.implementation: In predict_today.py and models/kelly.py, add EV threshold: only activate bet if (1/odds) * P_model < 0.909 (i.e., EV > 1.10). Log filtered bets to EV-filtered-bets.jsonl for analysis.
proposals.risk: low — reduces bet volume, improves quality

proposals.title: Fractional Kelly: Reduce multiplier from 1.0x to 0.3x
proposals.description: MDPI paper uses 0.3x Kelly multiplier (fractional-Kelly). Full Kelly is theoretically optimal but in practice leads to variance that wipes bankrolls on bad streaks. 0.3x Kelly = risk-adjusted growth that survives drawdowns. Apply in bankroll_manager.py.
proposals.implementation: In models/kelly.py, add KELLY_FRACTION = 0.3 config variable. Multiply Kelly bet size by 0.3. This reduces max single bet from ~5% bankroll to ~1.5% bankroll per position.
proposals.expected_roi_delta: Lower variance, same expected value per unit, better Sharpe

proposals.title: Systematic Rolling Form Windows (3/5/10/15 games)
proposals.description: MDPI paper uses rolling 5-game form indicators as key sequential features. Our engine likely has some rolling stats but not systematically across 3/5/10/15 game windows for all key metrics. Add systematic multi-window rolling features to engine.py.
proposals.implementation: Add Cat55: Systematic Rolling Form (20 features) to features/engine.py and hf-space/features/engine.py. Each feature: compute rolling window stats from game log table. form_momentum = win_pct_last3 - win_pct_last10 (positive = improving).
proposals.risk: medium — engine version change requires retest

cross_repo_applicability.political_alpha: EV filter and fractional-Kelly directly applicable to political trading. Rolling form → rolling policy velocity (same concept applied to political signal recency).
cross_repo_applicability.port_priority: P1 and P2 are 1-hour ports to nomos-political-alpha/models/kelly.py and ops/bankroll_manager.py
